summary.text: Stephen M. Ross is a Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives, representing District 63 (Alamance County), for the 2025-2026 session. The General Assembly's member page lists 6 terms served in the House.

paragraphs.text: The General Assembly's member page lists Stephen M. Ross's occupation as Financial Advisor.
